name: Fixture Container Platform
description: Makes the internal developer platform specific to a container orchestration foundation.

alphas.name: Platform
alphas.description: The shared technical foundation on which the organisation's services run.

states.name: Identified
states.description: The need for a shared foundation is understood and agreed.

checklist.name: Workload shape known
checklist.description: The kinds of workload the cluster must carry are described.

states.name: Available
states.description: The foundation exists and teams can use it.

checklist.name: Cluster reachable
checklist.description: A team can schedule a workload on the cluster without raising a ticket.

states.name: Operating
states.description: The foundation runs production workloads and is observed.

checklist.name: Capacity observed
checklist.description: Cluster capacity headroom is monitored and acted on before exhaustion.

workProducts.name: Platform Design
workProducts.description: The record of how the shared foundation is put together and why.

levelsOfDetail.name: Outline
levelsOfDetail.description: A first sketch, enough to argue about.

checklist.name: Sketch exists
checklist.description: An outline design exists and names its major components.

checklist.name: Buildable
checklist.description: An engineer unfamiliar with the design could build the cluster from it.
